title: Gold Aggregation Spec
description: Defines Silver-to-Gold transformation: KPIs, grain, schema type, aggregations.

source_table.description: Silver Iceberg table to read from

schema_type.description: Gold schema layout determined during discovery

dimensions.description: Dimension columns defining the aggregation grain

filter.description: Optional SQL WHERE clause for filtered aggregation

scd_type.description: Slowly Changing Dimension type (star schema only)

quality_threshold.description: Minimum quality score for Gold gate

publish_via_gate.description: When true this template writes to {iceberg_table}_staging instead of the real table, leaving publication to the quality gate. iceberg_table stays the real name so semantic.yaml, the LF-Tag grants and gold_spec.source_table keep pointing at it. Requires gate_before_publish on the workload's quality_spec and PROMOTE_TO on the quality task -- without both, the data is staged and never published.

atomic.description: For a `fact` table only: write one row per SOURCE row, straight from the pre-aggregation dataframe, instead of at the spec's `grain`. Use it to publish an atomic fact alongside the aggregate when a consumer needs a dimension that the aggregate grain does not carry — provider-level slicing off a daily plan/claim-type aggregate, for instance, which is otherwise impossible. An atomic fact republishes row-level detail into Gold, so under HIPAA it inherits the source zone's sensitivity and needs its own column-level controls; it is not a cheaper aggregate. Ignored for dimension and flat tables.

business_key.description: Natural key identifying one entity in this dimension. Used as the MERGE predicate when the table is written as SCD Type 2. REQUIRED when any dimensions[] attribute whose source_column appears in this table's columns declares scd_type 2: a Type 2 merge must know which rows are successive versions of the same entity, and because dimensions[] names attributes rather than tables there is nothing to infer it from. Every listed column must also appear in columns. Ignored for Type 1 dimensions and for fact/flat tables.

output_tables.description: For star_schema: list of fact + dimension tables. A dimension table is written as SCD Type 2 when any dimensions[] attribute whose source_column is among its columns declares scd_type 2; otherwise Type 1 (overwrite).

freshness_sla_hours.description: Maximum acceptable data staleness in hours

expression.description: Spark SQL expression (passed to F.expr) added to the Silver dataframe BEFORE aggregation. Used as input to measures or as additional grouping dimensions.

derived_silver_columns.description: Pre-aggregation derived columns computed from Silver before groupBy (e.g., late_arrival_int, attendance_score, overtime_calc).

expression.description: Spark SQL expression evaluated AFTER groupBy/agg (e.g., late_arrival_flag = late_count > 0).

post_aggregation_columns.description: Columns derived from aggregated measures (booleans, ratios, masking expressions over Gold dimensions).

post_aggregation_filter.description: Spark SQL predicate applied to the aggregated rows immediately before the write. Rows not satisfying it are dropped, not labelled. This is the only way to suppress a published cell: post_aggregation_columns can add a column but cannot remove a row, so a k-anonymity flag computed there is a boolean sitting next to the disclosed row rather than a suppression. Example for k=11: claim_count >= 11.
